更改自动记住，下次录制沿用。: Changes are remembered for your next recording.
无法保存录屏偏好，请检查本地存储后重试。: Could not save recording preferences. Check local storage and try again.
框选后使用工具栏标注、复制或保存；滚动截图也从选区工具栏开始。: Select an area, then annotate, copy or save from the toolbar. Start scrolling captures from the same toolbar.
设置格式与画质，选择范围后确认声音。录制中可暂停，停止后自动导出。: Choose format and quality, select an area and confirm audio. Pause when needed; stopping exports the recording.
把剪贴板文字、图片或本地图片贴在桌面，在贴图页管理显示和分组。: Pin clipboard text, images or local images to your desktop. Manage visibility and groups on the Pins page.
按键录入快捷键，清空可禁用；修改后自动生效。: Press keys to set a shortcut; clear to disable. Changes apply automatically.
（密钥随当前服务地址保存）: (Key is saved for the current service address)
关闭后，本次选择仍可使用；下次启动恢复默认目录。: When off, keep using this folder for this session and return to the default folder next launch.
历史限制无效：条目 100～5000、容量 50～2048 MiB、保留期 0～: Invalid history limits: 100–5000 items, 50–2048 MiB, and 0–3650 days.
自动按贴图尺寸、缩放与焦点调整。: Adjust automatically with pin size, zoom and focus.
应用于全部贴图，修改自动生效。: Applies to all pins. Changes take effect automatically.
贴图圆角需为 0～24 像素。: Pin corner radius must be 0–24 pixels.
请在桌面应用中使用贴图。: Use pins in the desktop app.
边框颜色需为六位十六进制颜色。: Border color must be a six-digit hexadecimal color.
单击选中 · Ctrl 多选 · Shift 连选 · 双击图片预览，文本复制: Click to select · Ctrl for multiple · Shift for range · Double-click images to preview, text to copy
选择条目 {0}，双击预览图片: Select entry {0}; double-click to preview image
历史图片预览失败。: Could not display the clipboard image.
下一张截图（.），最后一张后返回现场: Next capture (.), then return to the live session
用全局贴图快捷键恢复鼠标操作: Use the global pin shortcut to restore mouse interaction
鼠标穿透中 · 用全局贴图快捷键或托盘恢复: Click through active · Restore with the global pin shortcut or tray
测试会发送 Hello，可能产生费用。: The test sends Hello and may incur charges.
DeepL 仅支持官方 Free 或 Pro 的 /v2/translate 地: DeepL requires the official Free or Pro /v2/translate endpoint.
一次需要 1～50 段非空文字，合计不超过 32 KB。: Provide 1–50 non-empty text segments, totaling at most 32 KB.
DeepL 翻译额度已用尽，请检查账户用量。: DeepL translation quota exhausted. Check your account usage.
翻译结果数量不匹配或为空。: Translation results are missing, empty or do not match the requested count.
服务未保留受保护术语，请缩小选区或更换模型。: The service did not preserve protected terms. Select a smaller area or choose another model.
翻译配置已变更，请重新确认服务地址。: Translation settings changed. Confirm the service endpoint again.
翻译请求超过 128 KB，请缩小选区。: The translation request exceeds 128 KB. Select a smaller area.
点击“开始截图”，拖动框选需要的区域。: Click Start capture, then drag to select an area.
在选区工具栏标注、复制或保存；截长图请点“滚动截图”。: Use the selection toolbar to annotate, copy or save. For a long screenshot, choose Scroll capture.
滚动截图时慢慢滚动，停一下再继续；点“完成”保存，Esc 取消。: Scroll slowly and pause between movements. Click Finish to save, or press Esc to cancel.
普通截图可选择保存位置；长截图完成后自动保存 PNG 并复制。: Choose where to save a regular screenshot. Scrolling captures save a PNG and copy it when finished.
收起窗口后仍在托盘运行；退出应用请用托盘菜单。: The app keeps running in the tray when hidden. Use the tray menu to quit.
以后可从“帮助”重新打开引导。: Reopen this guide anytime from Help.
滚动截图：框选正文后慢慢滚动: Scroll capture: select the content, then scroll slowly
贴图，按 Tab 进入工具栏，右键打开菜单: Pin; press Tab for tools, right-click for the menu
拖动移动 · 滚轮缩放 · 右键菜单 · Esc 隐藏: Drag to move · Wheel to zoom · Right-click for menu · Esc to hide
作为保存对话框的默认位置，保存时仍可另选目录。: Default location for the save dialog. You can choose another folder when saving.
备份包含主配置、快捷键和保存目录，不包含密钥、历史记录及图片视频。: Backup includes settings, shortcuts and save folders. Credentials, history and media files are excluded.
配置已导出，包含快捷键和截图、录屏保存目录。: Settings exported with shortcuts and screenshot/recording folders.
配置已导入，快捷键和保存目录已更新。: Settings imported. Shortcuts and save folders are updated.
请先修正未保存的设置，再重试。: Fix unsaved settings before trying again.
移出输入框完成；单击选中，双击文字编辑: Move outside to finish; click to select, double-click text to edit
单击标注拖动；Alt 拖动叠加绘制: Click annotations to drag; Alt-drag to draw over them
已到选区边界，可缩小字号继续输入: Selection boundary reached; reduce the font size to continue typing
请允许弹出窗口后重试。: Allow pop-up windows and try again.
模拟更新，不会下载文件或退出应用。: Update preview; no files are downloaded and the app stays open.
在这里设置延时并开始截图，选区后可标注、复制或保存。: Set a delay and start a capture here, then annotate, copy or save your selection.
点击“快捷键”，查看或修改功能按键。: Click Shortcuts to view or change key bindings.
点击按键框录入快捷键，修改后自动保存；清空可禁用。: Click a key field to record a shortcut. Changes save automatically; clear it to disable.
点击“识别与翻译”，安装本地资源或配置翻译服务。: Click Recognition & Translation to install local resources or configure a translation service.
点击“通用”，设置外观、保存目录和启动偏好。: Click General to set appearance, save folders and startup preferences.
点击“帮助”完成引导，以后也可以在这里重新查看。: Click Help to finish the tour. You can restart it here anytime.
当前为测试版，始终接收测试版更新；升级到正式版后按此开关决定。: This is a prerelease build and always receives prerelease updates. After upgrading to a stable release, this switch applies.
安装会退出应用，请先保存工作并结束录屏。: Installation exits the app. Save your work and finish recording first.
连接与凭据在服务管理中维护。: Manage connections and credentials in Services.
本机服务可不填密钥: Local services may omit a key
更多在线 OCR 或本机模型可在服务管理中添加。: Add online OCR services or local models in Services.
每个模型或账号可单独保存服务，OCR 与翻译分别选择。密钥仅保存在系统凭据库，不: Save a connection for each model or account. Select OCR and translation services independently. Keys stay in the system credential store and are excluded from exports.
此模型支持图片输入，可用于 OCR: This model accepts images and can be used for OCR
免费版：1 MB/文件、25,000 次/月、500 次/日/IP；大图会自动压: Free plan: 1 MB/file, 25,000 requests/month, 500 requests/day/IP. Large images are compressed. Commercial use is allowed with no uptime guarantee.
从官方控制台复制对应模型的同步 /ocr 地址和 Token。模型由该产线决定，: Copy the synchronous /ocr URL and token for the selected model from the official console. The endpoint determines the model. Account terms govern quotas and commercial use.
当前通过 API Key / Token 接入；浏览器登录用于获取凭据，不会自动: Connect using an API key or token. Browser sign-in lets you obtain credentials; it does not authorize Snap Desk automatically.
密钥过长或含控制字符。: Key is too long or contains control characters.
点击“文字识别”安装本地资源；翻译和在线服务有独立设置页。: Click OCR to install local resources. Translation and online services have separate settings pages.
请先在“翻译”中选择服务，或在“服务管理”中添加服务。: Select a service in Translation or add one in Services.
请先在主窗口的翻译页选择服务，或在服务管理中添加服务。: Select a service in Translation or add one in Services in the main window.
OCR 模型未下载或校验失败，请在“文字识别”页下载识别资源。: OCR models are missing or failed verification. Download resources in OCR.
请先填写 API Key / Token，再启用在线 OCR。: Enter an API key or token before enabling online OCR.
OCR 会将选区图片发送到此服务，可能产生费用。: OCR sends the selected image to this service. Charges may apply.
所选 PaddleOCR 接口不支持此模型。: The selected PaddleOCR endpoint does not support this model.
官方异步接口支持选择模型；自定义同步 /ocr 地址需从控制台获取。云端额度与商: The official asynchronous API supports model selection. Obtain a custom synchronous /ocr endpoint from your console. Account terms govern quotas and commercial use.
填写控制台提供的完整 /ocr 地址: Enter the full /ocr endpoint from your console
鼠标停留屏幕顶部中央时展开: Show when hovering at the top center of the screen
剪贴板记录已关闭，暂存架仅展示已有历史。: Clipboard recording is off. Only existing history is shown.
与剪贴板历史共用数据；删除历史会同步移除卡片。固定仅保留架上位置，不阻止历史自动: Uses clipboard history. Deleting history removes the corresponding cards. Keeping a card on the shelf does not prevent history cleanup.
单击复制，拖动分享: Click to copy, drag to share
取下为贴图: Take off as a desktop pin
从架子移除，保留历史: Remove from shelf, keep in history
密钥随当前服务地址保存。: The key is stored for the current service address.
固定窗口，失去焦点时不收起: Keep open when the window loses focus
记录已暂停，新复制的内容不会保存。: Recording is paused. Newly copied content is not saved.
已开始记录，仅记录此后复制的内容。: Recording started. Only content copied from now on is saved.
请在剪贴板窗口清理历史，勿手动删除数据库。: Clear history from the clipboard window. Do not delete the database manually.
快捷键唤出独立窗口，搜索或按类型筛选；回车或双击复制并收起，右键可贴图、收藏或删: Open the clipboard window with the shortcut, then search or filter by type. Press Enter or double-click to copy and hide; right-click to pin, favorite or delete. Adjust what is recorded on the Clipboard page.
拖动手柄或 Alt+↑/↓ 调整顺序，改写只影响本次导出。: Drag the handle or press Alt+↑/↓ to reorder. Edits only affect this export.
文本存为 TXT，图片按原图存为 PNG，放进新建的批次文件夹。: Text is saved as TXT and images as original PNGs, in a new batch folder.
素材已全部移除，关闭后重新选择。: All items were removed. Close and select again.
预览为近似排版，文字换行以导出结果为准。: The preview is approximate; line breaks in the exported file may differ.
PDF 图片总量超过 6400 万像素，请分批导出。: Images in the PDF exceed 64 million pixels. Export in smaller batches.
PDF 超过 1000 页，请分批导出。: The PDF exceeds 1000 pages. Export in smaller batches.
长图超过 3200 万像素，请减少素材或改用 PDF。: The long image exceeds 32 million pixels. Remove some items or use PDF.
改写文本与素材数量不一致。: Edited text does not match the number of items.
改写后的文本不能为空，且不超过 1 MiB。: Edited text must not be empty and must not exceed 1 MiB.
只有文本素材可以改写。: Only text items can be edited.
点击识别框定位文字: Click a box to find its text
回车或双击粘贴到原窗口 · Ctrl+1～9 粘贴第 N 条 · 单击选中 ·: Enter or double-click to paste into the previous window · Ctrl+1–9 to paste item N · Click to select · Ctrl for multiple · Shift for range · Ctrl+C to copy only · Right-click for more
回车或双击复制并收起 · Ctrl+1～9 复制第 N 条 · 单击选中 · C: Enter or double-click to copy and hide · Ctrl+1–9 to copy item N · Click to select · Ctrl for multiple · Shift for range · Ctrl+C to copy only · Right-click for more
回车或双击后直接粘贴到原窗口: Paste into the previous window on Enter or double-click
不记录这些程序复制的内容: Do not record content copied by these apps
程序文件名，用逗号分隔，如 KeePass.exe, 1Password.exe: Executable names separated by commas, e.g. KeePass.exe, 1Password.exe
排除应用无效：最多 50 个程序文件名，每个不超过 100 字且不含路径。: Invalid excluded apps: up to 50 executable names, 100 characters each, without paths.
识别后自动合并换行: Merge line breaks automatically after recognition
把同一段落的多行拼成一行，空行仍分段；可在结果里还原。: Joins the lines of a paragraph into one; blank lines still separate paragraphs. You can restore the original in the result.
直接执行时不显示工具栏；按住 Ctrl 框选可临时保留工具栏。录屏和截图翻译不受: Direct actions skip the toolbar; hold Ctrl while selecting to keep it once. Recording and capture translation are not affected.
